bobsweep - bio robot vacuum & mop with s.description: Inspired by nature and engineered in the US and Canada, Bio robotic vacuum cleaner and mop blends superior technology with eco-conscious design. Equipped with bObsweep’s advanced Quantum Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (QSLAM) technology, real-time computing, and LiDAR laser vision, Bio is a navigation expert, mapping and color-marking your space in just minutes without any training runs. As he cleans, Bio moves smoothly across various floor types in straight lines, ensuring every inch is covered and every piece of debris is lifted. The bObsweep app provides complete control over Bio, allowing you to manage multiple floor maps, define NoSweep and NoMop Zones, adjust vacuum and mop settings, or review cleaning history. You can also control Bio hands-free with Alexa or Google Home. To ensure a thorough clean, Bio combines dual-brush sweeping, three vacuum settings (low, medium, and high), and a wet mop for added shine. After each clean, Bio’s auto-emptying station seals debris in a 3.5-liter, odor-blocking, activated charcoal-lined reusable dustbag while Bio recharges for the next task. Made from bio-based plastic, Bio offers the durability of traditional ABS while minimizing his carbon footprint through renewable, plant-based ingredients. Designed with user privacy in mind, Bio never records images of your home or its inhabitants, ensuring your data remains completely private.
